January 2, 1971
2014-12-12T00:01:27+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/january-2-1971-53743

Bhutto’s envoy Golam Mostafa Khar and Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman holds a meeting that decided for governance issues between Awami League chief Sheikh Mujib and Pakistan People’s Party chief ZA Bhutto on January 17. The elaborate meeting takes place in the residence of Sheikh Mujib and discusses cooperation of both parties to formulate governance policies.
